title: Sh Suhyup Bank says a hacking attack leaked personal information of 54 customers, per Financial News
date_note: Financial News of 27 November says the bank confirmed the leak the day before; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Financial News reports that Sh Suhyup Bank confirmed a hacking attack that leaked personal information of 54 customers, and reported it to the Financial Supervisory Service. The article says loan information, credit information and addresses were leaked. It says the bank will notify affected customers individually and is investigating how the intrusion happened.
plain: Financial News reports that Sh Suhyup Bank confirmed a hack that leaked personal data of 54 customers, including loan and credit information and addresses. The bank says it will notify those customers.
exec: A South Korean bank reportedly confirmed that loan and credit information of 54 customers leaked in a hacking attack and reported it to the regulator.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The article says the bank will notify affected customers individually and operates a damage reporting center for inquiries.
